sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Deep Purple Glass Bangle Set with Golden Ghoonghroo Accents – 16-Piece
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Enrich your ethnic look with this striking set of 12 deep purple glass bangles and 4 golden ghoonghroo bangles. This fashionable ensemble adds a beautiful melodic charm to your attire. To preserve the brilliant golden luster of the charms, keep them away from moisture and store safely after use.
To ensure safe delivery, prepaid payment is mandatory as this is a fragile item
